prompt.text: Complete this bounded research task exactly: compare JSON and YAML for human-edited configuration. Call research_plan_start with exactly two branches, JSON and YAML, each budget {searches:0, reads:2}. The JSON branch must read https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc8259 once; the YAML branch must read https://yaml.org/ once. Immediately dispatch one research-planner child per branch. Each child must publish branch_plan done with exactly one source lead and exactly one combined claim stating one property and one limitation, using the original URL; do not use the second read. When both reports are terminal, the parent must web_read those two lead URLs, record exactly one parent-validated evidence card per lead using the exact claim text, then call plan_settle with a summary shorter than 240 characters. Do not search, delegate again, add extra leads, or broaden the question. If a source fails or its quote cannot support the combined claim, mark only that branch deferred with value, risk, and rationale.

negative_control.text: What are the two JSON structural types? Give a short answer from one official source.
